name: hermes-agency
description: A curated pack of professional Hermes profiles designed to work together as a digital product agency.

profiles.name: agency-orchestrator
profiles.description: Coordinates multi-specialist work: decomposes goals, routes tasks to the best Agency profile, manages dependencies and blockers, and synthesizes validated results. Use for complex work that spans roles; do not use for implementation.

profiles.name: agency-product-manager
profiles.description: Owns product intent: turns ambiguous goals into scoped outcomes, requirements, priorities, acceptance criteria, and product decisions. Use for what/why/for-whom questions; not for architecture or implementation.

profiles.name: agency-technical-lead
profiles.description: Leads engineering execution across specialists: turns product scope into a technical plan, assigns technical ownership, resolves implementation tradeoffs, and protects integration quality. Use for cross-engineering coordination.

profiles.name: agency-software-architect
profiles.description: Designs durable software boundaries, interfaces, data flows, protocols, and architecture decisions for changes with cross-system impact. Use when structure matters across components; not for routine implementation.

profiles.name: agency-backend-engineer
profiles.description: Builds and debugs server-side application logic, APIs, services, domain models, persistence integration, background jobs, and backend tests. Use for application backend implementation; not infrastructure ownership.

profiles.name: agency-frontend-engineer
profiles.description: Builds and debugs user-facing web/app interfaces, state management, client integration, accessibility, interaction behavior, and frontend tests. Use for implemented UI behavior; design decisions belong to Product Design.

profiles.name: agency-ai-engineer
profiles.description: Builds and evaluates AI/agent features: model integration, prompting, tool use, retrieval, agent workflows, structured outputs, evals, and failure controls. Use for AI-specific implementation and empirical model behavior.

profiles.name: agency-data-engineer
profiles.description: Builds and maintains data ingestion, transformation, pipelines, schemas, quality checks, analytical stores, and reproducible data workflows. Use when data movement/shape is the product problem, not ordinary app persistence.

profiles.name: agency-infrastructure-engineer
profiles.description: Owns runtime infrastructure, CI/CD, deployment, environments, containers, networking, observability, reliability, and infrastructure-as-code. Use for platform/operations implementation, not application feature logic.

profiles.name: agency-security-engineer
profiles.description: Owns application and infrastructure security analysis, threat modeling, auth/authz, secrets, trust boundaries, vulnerability remediation, and security validation. Use for security-sensitive design or review.

profiles.name: agency-qa-engineer
profiles.description: Owns independent quality validation: test strategy, reproducible bug investigation, exploratory testing, regression coverage, end-to-end verification, and release confidence. Use to prove behavior, not to implement the feature.

profiles.name: agency-code-reviewer
profiles.description: Performs independent implementation review for correctness, regressions, maintainability, tests, API compatibility, and risky edge cases. Use after code exists; not as the primary implementer.

profiles.name: agency-product-designer
profiles.description: Designs user flows, information architecture, interaction patterns, UI states, accessibility behavior, and product UX specifications. Use for how the product should work for users; implementation belongs to Frontend.

profiles.name: agency-brand-designer
profiles.description: Owns visual identity for products and public-facing material: brand systems, art direction, typography, color, imagery, logo usage, and campaign visual consistency. Use for identity; not product interaction design.

profiles.name: agency-researcher
profiles.description: Investigates technical, product, market, user, and competitive questions using primary evidence where possible; compares options, cites sources, and separates facts from inference. Use when uncertainty should be reduced before a decision.

profiles.name: agency-marketing-strategist
profiles.description: Owns positioning, audience, messaging strategy, channel choices, campaign plans, launch narrative, and marketing measurement. Use for why/how to market; execution copy belongs to Content/Social specialists.

profiles.name: agency-content-writer
profiles.description: Writes polished public-facing copy and long-form content: websites, articles, announcements, case studies, launch copy, scripts, and marketing assets. Use for finished prose; strategy belongs to Marketing/Product.

profiles.name: agency-social-media-manager
profiles.description: Plans and executes platform-native social content, post series, threads, demo narratives, community responses, and content calendars. Use for social distribution and engagement; positioning belongs to Marketing Strategy.

profiles.name: agency-technical-writer
profiles.description: Creates and maintains accurate developer/user documentation, READMEs, tutorials, architecture explanations, runbooks, API docs, migration guides, and release notes from verified implementation.

profiles.name: agency-git-steward
profiles.description: Owns safe source-control integration: repository state, branches, commits, rebases, merges, pull requests, conflict handling, history hygiene, and release-ready checkpoints. Use for git operations, not feature implementation.
